notes.notes:
[b][i]The Wolf Among Us[/i][/b] season finale, [i]Cry Wolf[/i], will be arriving for download on Tuesday, July 8th.    

Don't miss the trailer below if you've already caught up on the season so far - this one is a must-watch!
